art_direction: Stylish rendered game illustrations with varied painted plaster, glass, steel, concrete and selective stone; less orange masonry; full-color newspaper ink/halftone texture.
common_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE original full-color rendered illustration for a city-builder game's newspaper and notices, landscape 3:2, full bleed.
Input images are user-selected architectural STYLE references: stepped towers with ribbed limestone/metal, charcoal blue-gray glass, pale concrete, blue painted townhouses with slate roofs. Preserve this elegant, detailed painted-rendered craft: clear modeled volumes, fine architectural edges, authored material texture and shaped highlights. Do not copy their isolated cutout layout or backgrounds.
USER'S FINAL ART DIRECTION: stylish rendered game illustration, not a photograph. A BELIEVABLE MIX OF MATERIALS AND BUILDING COLORS. Avoid both extremes: endless orange/brown brick or stone, and a city made entirely of white marble. Homes can have dusty blue, muted sage, soft plum and gray painted plaster with cream trim; offices can have charcoal steel, blue-gray glazing and weathered concrete; civic buildings can use restrained pale limestone; industrial sites use practical concrete, painted steel, zinc and metal. Each building should have its own purposeful material identity. A small amount of warm brick or limestone detail is fine, but no dominant orange masonry, no uniform white facades, no marble veining or glossy marble surfaces, no global amber/sepia grade. Warm window light is selective and secondary, not filling every window. Balanced neutral daylight, rich controlled color, soft directional shadows.
Keep people and vehicles visibly illustrated, with simplified sculpted features. Refined city-builder asset finish, not chibi, plastic toys, crude low-poly, flat vector, photography or pixel art. Prefer intentional painted shapes over photographic surface noise.
Composition: one continuous scene, landscape about 3:2. Readable main subject and clear silhouette, restrained supporting detail, legible at 310x200px. Moderately raised three-quarter perspective when useful. No need for a mountain skyline, river or bridge; choose the subject's own setting.
No words, lettering, logos, labels, captions, panels, frames, watermark or newspaper page layout. Not grayscale or monochrome.
print_finish: Print finish: make the image look like a full-color illustration printed inside a well-designed newspaper. Fine, restrained CMYK halftone dots visible in shaded areas, subtle cool off-white newsprint fiber, slightly softened contrast, gently muted colored inks and tiny natural ink variation. Preserve rich distinguishable colors, especially blues, greens, slate and neutral masonry. Delicate texture, clear architectural detail and readable silhouettes at small size. White balance remains neutral, no sepia, no orange tint, no aged yellow paper, no black-and-white or grayscale. No fold creases, rips, distressed damage, heavy grunge, heavy outlines or large comic-book dot patterns. This is ONLY the image area, full bleed: no newspaper page, headline, lettering, frame or margins.
